note: Fictional. Structure adapted from a television drama; surface (names, profession, illness, means of death, places, dates) invented. Conversations take place 5-12 October 2026.

settled.fact: Elena dismisses Tomas after a dispensing error that each blamed on the other.
Tomas files an anonymous report to the State Board of Pharmacy that a pharmacist at the chain works with an undisclosed medical condition. His assistant helped him draft it.
The Board opens a fitness-to-practise review of Elena and orders an independent medical assessment.

settled.fact: Northline Pharmacy Group approaches Gareth about buying the chain; an open review against a co-owner would hold up the deal.
Gareth presses Elena to sell him her share to protect the licence; she signs on 20 March after the assessor recommends restrictions on her practice.
Farewell gathering for Elena at the harbour shop.
Tomas visits Elena at home to make peace. She tells him she knows 'someone close' reported her and that she never trusted him. He says nothing about the report and leaves.

settled.fact: Elena's neurologist tells her the disease is progressing faster than expected.

At night Elena's car leaves the coast road at Hollin Point; there are no braking marks.
